title: hollin water
summary: An orchard by a lake, drawn in pencil on white paper. Wherever you walk, watercolour bleeds out from your footsteps and stays.
medium: walkable 3d scene, three.js, surface shaders + a paper pass, single file

specs.controls: click, WASD, mouse, shift, space, wheel
specs.passes: the scene, repainted in its own surface shaders, then one paper pass for outlines, sky and margin
specs.wash map: 256 x 256 cells over 128 m, each storing how covered it is and when the colour arrived
specs.inspired by: watercolour by blendi on patch.gg (MIT / CC0), technique adapted; place and character are new
